display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AI-assisted disposition layer
absorbs a measured share of
Tier 1 known-pattern volume

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Absorption confirmed stable
across a full quarter,
not just a pilot window?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hold headcount; keep measuring.
Do not backfill attrition yet,
but do not reduce either.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Does Part 12's cross-training
matrix show an existing
bench-depth gap?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Redeploy freed capacity into
the gap via a paired rotation
(Part 12 §3)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Is autonomous-disposition
accuracy independently
audited yet (§4)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Convert one or more freed
seats into a disposition-audit
role before reducing anything

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Is the volume drop large
enough that even audited,
redeployed capacity exceeds
realistic near-term need?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reduce headcount only through
attrition and a communicated
redeployment offer (§6) —
never a same-quarter RIF
timed to the tool's ROI case
